identity.title: Debate: Does the God of the Bible Exist? (Kyle Butt / Dan Barker)
identity.eventLocation: University of South Carolina, Columbia, South Carolina
identity.speakerIdentityBasis: Named introductions, timed opening/rebuttal turns, cross-examination direct address and alternating closings; secondary publisher transcript Part 1 printed pages 1–59 corroborates wording and turns.

acquisition.method: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally

content.coverageNote: Full recording captions are preserved, including the excluded audience segment. All formal rounds and both closings are covered. Seven gaps over ten seconds occur at handoffs, pauses and applause; adjacent words agree with the publisher transcript. The final forty seconds follow completed closing remarks and applause. This is a textual cross-check, not direct audio listening.
content.captionCaution: Automatic captions contain corrupted proper names, isolated missing negations and mixed-speaker boundary words. Canonical text is unchanged; uncertain recognition must never become a speaker defect.

participants.substantiveAdvocatesInOriginal: Two named primary speakers plus substantive audience interventions

editorApprovedScope.userApproval: Assess only the formal debates and closings.
editorApprovedScope.requiredReaderDisclosure: This assessment covers the formal opening statements, rebuttals, and cross-examination (approximately 5:54–1:08:57), plus both closing statements (1:46:09–1:57:06). The entire audience Q&A, including both speakers’ answers and dependent replies, is excluded at the editor’s request. Neither speaker receives credit or penalty for excluded material. These scores assess the formal rounds and closings, not the complete event.

excludedIntervals.reason: Explicit user-approved exclusion of the complete audience-question segment and surrounding transition, every audience intervention, and both primary speakers’ answers and dependent replies. Resume at the independently stated closing remarks; the carried-over word “wom” in event 2563 remains excluded.

editorApprovedScope.boundaryBasis: Canonical caption events preserve absolute video timestamps. Event 124 begins with a moderator carry-over “exist”; event 2563 begins with the Q&A carry-over “wom”. Those words remain unscored and ineligible for quotations. Event 1652 ends with moderator applause logistics. All substantive formal speech and both completed closing arguments are retained.
editorApprovedScope.outsideWindowDisposition: Introductions and logistics before the first debater turn, and applause and final thanks after the last completed closing argument, are unscored.
editorApprovedScope.coherenceReview: Formal openings establish both cases, followed by rebuttals and cross-examination. Both complete closings are retained. Butt’s closing refers to the excluded eye-design answer: assess only his independently stated closing claim, with no evidence, reply credit, missing-response penalty or burden inference imported from Q&A. All closing arguments must stand on their own or retained formal evidence.

participants.questionHandling: The complete audience-question segment and all dependent primary responses are excluded. No credit, penalty, response link, quotation or absence inference may use that material.

duplicateAudit.identityNote: No matching video or Butt–Barker 2009 event in catalogue, standalone registry or production ledgers. Butt–Shermer and other Barker events are distinct.

crossCheck.publisherAffiliation: Author Kyle Butt / Apologetics Press; use only Part 1 debate transcript as secondary wording/turn corroboration, never later rebuttals or editorial commentary.
crossCheck.publisherPagesUsed: Printed 1–59, PDF 21–79; controller sampled pages recorded in source notes rather than claiming complete secondary-text review.
